messages.subject: Project Fairway - completion bible
messages.plaintextBody:
Elena,

Quick one unrelated to what you're on - Crestview's team have asked for the completion bible for Project Fairway (the FairChain Series A). Do you know if the final PDF set was ever sent to Margaret Holloway, or is it still sitting in the data room? If you can't find it, ask James - he ran that one. No rush, end of week is fine.

Sarah
